The main takeaway from our work is that
drought stress affects growth and biomass allocation in A. digitata seedlings, but provenance effects are not related to environmental conditions at the site of origin.
seedlings from different provenances respond differently to long-term drought, and the selection for drought-tolerance at seedling stage is possible.

provenances from the same species can be very different in their responses to drought stress, and that this variability should be considered when selecting provenances for reforestation in semi-arid areas.
